annotations.title: Public holidays by country and year

description: List the official public holidays of a country for a year, with local and English names and whether each is nationwide. Covers the countries supported by Nager.Date. For Chile, cl_feriados uses a curated statutory table and is preferred. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /days/holidays via x402.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, DE, BR.

year.description: Year between 1975 and 2075; default current year.
